item.title: New rules for sharing the Colorado River start today
item.description: Oct. 1 is when new federal rules for sharing the Colorado River start. It's going to be messy and courts will likely have to weigh in.

item.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
item.description: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

item.title: The race to protect Santa Rosa Island's rare, damaged Torrey pines
item.description: In May, a fire damaged 80% of the trees one of the only two naturally-occurring groves of Torrey Pines in the world. The National Park Service is trying to help them recover.
item.content:encoded: In May, a fire damaged 80% of the trees one of the only two naturally-occurring groves of Torrey Pines in the world. The National Park Service is trying to help them recover.

item.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
item.description: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

item.title: Smoke ecology studies what can be done to prevent harms from wildfire smoke
item.description: A new field of study called "smoke ecology" strives to understand the smoke blowing off wildfires, and whether anything can be done to protect the environment's inhabitants from it.
item.content:encoded: A new field of study called "smoke ecology" strives to understand the smoke blowing off wildfires, and whether anything can be done to protect the environment's inhabitants from it.

item.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
item.description: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

item.title: Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii
item.description: Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.

item.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'
item.description: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.

item.title: This 'fire amoeba' pushes the limit of what's possible for complex life
item.description: Scientists have found a species they've named the fire amoeba, which is capable of reproducing at 145°F and continuing to move up to temperatures of 147°F — a record for complex eukaryotic life.
